mapper.sql: (SELECT MIN(first_submit.time) FROM contest_record first_submit WHERE first_submit.cid = cr.cid AND first_submit.uid = cr.uid AND first_submit.pid = cr.pid AND first_submit.cpid = cr.cpid AND first_submit.time BETWEEN 0 AND cr.time)
mapper.select:
SELECT cr.id,cr.cid,cr.uid,cr.pid,cr.cpid,cr.display_id,cr.submit_id,u.username,cr.status,cr.submit_time, cr.time,cr.score,cr.use_time,cr.checked,cr.gmt_create,cr.gmt_modified, CASE WHEN cr.score = 0 THEN ELSE (SELECT MIN(first_score.time) FROM contest_record first_score WHERE first_score.cid = cr.cid AND first_score.uid = cr.uid AND first_score.pid = cr.pid AND first_score.cpid = cr.cpid AND first_score.score = cr.score AND first_score.status IS NOT NULL AND first_score.time BETWEEN 0 AND cr.time) END AS first_score_time, u.gender,u.realname as realname,u.avatar,u.school,u.nickname FROM (SELECT uid,pid,cpid,MAX(time) AS time FROM contest_record cr
GROUP BY uid,pid,cpid) t, contest_record cr,user_info u WHERE t.uid = cr.uid AND t.pid =cr.pid AND t.cpid = cr.cpid AND u.uuid = cr.uid AND t.time = cr.time AND ORDER BY cr.time ASC, cr.id ASC

SELECT cr.id,cr.cid,cr.uid,cr.pid,cr.cpid,cr.display_id,cr.submit_id,u.username,cr.status,cr.submit_time, cr.time,cr.score,cr.use_time,cr.checked,cr.gmt_create,cr.gmt_modified, CASE WHEN cr.score = 0 THEN ELSE cr.time END AS first_score_time, u.gender,u.realname as realname,u.avatar,u.school,u.nickname FROM (SELECT uid,pid,cpid,MAX(score) AS score FROM contest_record cr
GROUP BY uid,pid,cpid) t, contest_record cr,user_info u WHERE t.uid = cr.uid AND t.pid =cr.pid AND t.cpid = cr.cpid AND u.uuid = cr.uid AND t.score = cr.score AND ORDER BY cr.time ASC, cr.id ASC
